overview: The Medford School Committee received updates on COVID-19 health measures, alternative assessments, administrative professional development, and the family engagement hub. The committee also approved a contract for high school hot water heater repairs and voted to advance the annual budget timeline starting in January.

items.title: Superintendent's Report
items.summary: Superintendent Edouard-Vincent presented updates on district COVID-19 positivity rates, student vaccination clinics, job fairs, and upcoming school events.

items.title: MCAS Alternative Assessment Report
items.summary: Director of Pupil Services Joan Bowen reported on the 2020–2021 MCAS Alternative Assessment process and results for 17 participating students.

items.title: Administrator Professional Development Report
items.summary: Superintendent Resident Carmen Williams outlined ongoing professional development programming for administrators focused on instructional leadership and data analysis.

items.title: Engagement Hub Report
items.summary: District staff reported on the creation of the Engagement Hub and the deployment of school-based re-engagement specialists to support student and family connections.

items.title: Medford High School Hot Water Heater Contract
items.summary: Approved awarding a contract to Enterprise Equipment Company Inc. for $368,000 to repair or replace the Medford High School hot water heater.

items.title: Presentations of the Public
items.summary: The committee opened the floor for public comment, but no presentations or emails were submitted.

items.title: McGlynn Elementary Classroom Maintenance Update
items.summary: Assistant Superintendent David Murphy updated the committee on scheduled water testing and structural analysis to address recurring leaks in McGlynn Elementary kindergarten classrooms.

items.title: Updated Budget Schedule Motion
items.summary: Approved an amended motion to begin the annual budget process in January with a Committee of the Whole meeting to allow for earlier and more competitive hiring practices.

items.title: Reports Requested and Condolences
items.summary: Tabled the report on superintendent goals to December and expressed condolences to Member Kathy Kreatz following a family bereavement.
